description: Triggers start a delegated Hands run when a source fires: a monitor change, a schedule, an inbound message, a webhook, a fact change or a user command. A trigger with a condition (for example price below a threshold) fires only after the observed value is confirmed by a second agreeing observation; a single glitch never fires. The user's approval policy is evaluated at firing time, so tightening it after creation blocks the action. Each trigger has a rate limit, an optional per-firing spend limit and a circuit breaker that disables it after N consecutive failures and notifies the user. action=create adds a trigger; action=list lists them; action=pause, resume and revoke change one (revoke is one call and final); action=firings returns the audit of observations and decisions.

breaker_threshold.description: Create: consecutive failures before it disables

condition.description: Create: subject, key, op (lt|lte|gt|gte|eq|changed), threshold, kind, currency, confirmations (min 2)

interval_s.description: Create: seconds between runs for a schedule source

label.description: Create: a name for the trigger

run_template.description: Create: start_url, allowed_domains, instruction, mode, risk_class, recipe, ttl_s

source_ref.description: Create: monitor id or mailbox address the source watches

spend_limit.description: Create: most one firing may spend, in currency

trigger_id.description: Required for pause, resume, revoke and firings
